name: show_heading
label: Show section heading
help_text: Turns the section heading below on/off without clearing its content.

name: section_heading
label: Section heading
help_text: Normal text uses the Heading color setting below (default Blue). Wrap text in Bold to render it Purple 900, Arial Black, weight 900 - regardless of the Heading color selection. This treatment is scoped to this module's section heading only - it does not affect grid item titles or global typography.

name: show_paragraph
label: Show section paragraph
help_text: Turns the section paragraph below on/off without clearing its content.

name: section_paragraph
label: Section paragraph
help_text: Renders using the theme's global typography.
default: Optional subhead - the 2×2 framing in one sentence.

name: items
label: Grid items
help_text: Each item has an icon or image, a Title (Heading 4), an optional Subtitle (Heading 6), and a Description. A thin divider (#E3DDF3) separates items; the whole grid sits inside one purple frame.

children.name: show_media
children.label: Show media
children.help_text: Turns this item's icon/image on/off without clearing its content. On by default.

children.name: icon_settings
children.label: Icon settings
children.help_text: Hidden entirely when Show media above is off, so no icon configuration fields are left visible with nothing to configure.

children.name: icon_type
children.label: Icon source
children.help_text: Choose whether this item's icon is an uploaded image or an icon from HubSpot's Icon Library

children.name: icon_image
children.label: Icon image
children.help_text: Placeholder default - reuses this theme's existing icon-example.png asset (already used by other modules) until a dedicated image is supplied. Replace through this field.

children.name: icon_color
children.label: Icon color
children.help_text: Only applies when Icon source above is set to HubSpot Icon Library. Independent of the section heading color.

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.help_text: Renders as Heading 4, inheriting the theme's default Heading 4 color - no module-level override.

children.name: subtitle
children.label: Subtitle
children.help_text: Optional - leave empty to hide. Renders as Heading 6, inheriting the theme's default Heading 6 color.

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.help_text: Renders using the theme's global typography - no color inherited from the section heading, item title, or item subtitle.
children.default: Fuller copy room than the card grids - three to four lines per quadrant for paired arguments.

default.title: Quadrant One
default.subtitle: Subhead Slot
default.description: Fuller copy room than the card grids - three to four lines per quadrant for paired arguments.

default.title: Quadrant Two
default.description: Use for 2×2 framings: assess / harden / prove / report, or the four care-abouts.

default.title: Quadrant Three
default.description: Hairline dividers inside; the 2px purple frame closes the whole box as one object.

default.title: Quadrant Four
default.description: Ribbon exits the final quadrant - the box ends the brand way.

name: vector_visible
label: Show decorative vector
help_text: Optional decorative graphic anchored to the bottom-right corner of the grid frame.

name: vector
label: Decorative vector
help_text: Placeholder default - reuses this theme's existing vector-image.svg asset (already used by other modules) until a dedicated vector is supplied. Replace through this field.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding on desktop. Left/right are hidden - horizontal spacing comes from .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding at the theme's mobile breakpoint (max-width: 767px), independent of the desktop value above.

children.name: heading_color
children.label: Section heading color
children.help_text: Applies only to the section heading's non-Bold text - never to grid item titles/subtitles/descriptions. Bold text in the section heading always renders Purple 900 regardless of this selection.

children.name: columns
children.label: Columns (desktop)
children.help_text: Controls the grid's column count on desktop (>= 768px). Always 1 column below that, regardless of this setting.
